metadata.case_name: CHAN SHEK HO v. SHIU HO CHI AND OTHERS

plaintiff.occupation_before: self-employed driver of a self-owned truck (Hing Shing Transportation Company)

injuries.description: fracture of the right posterior mandibular body (angle fracture)
source: fracture of the right posterior mandibular body (angle fracture)

injuries.description: left mandibular condyle fracture with mild displacement
source: a fracture at left mandibular condyle with respectively minimal and mild displacement
left mandibular condyle fracture with mild displacement
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of condylar process of mandible

injuries.description: 4cm superficial abrasion over the left elbow
source: 4cm superficial abrasion over the left elbow

injuries.description: history of 2 carcinomas at the left side of the tongue (treated 2003)
source: 2 carcinomas at the left side of the tongue
extensive osteoradionecrosis affecting the mandible and the poor healing ability

injuries.description: visible depressed scar with loss of subcutaneous tissue at the midline of lower lip/chin (related to prior surgery)
injuries.body_part: midline of lower lip and chin
source: a visible depressed scar (related to the surgical access for the tongue carcinoma excision) with loss of subcutaneous tissue at the midline of lower lip/chin

manifestations.description: mild tenderness over both cheek regions
some bleeding from his oral gingivae
inability to chew solid food; restricted to soft/liquid diet
exposed necrotic bone on the right side of the right mandibular premolar to molar region and smaller exposed bone area in the midline of the mandible and left posterior mandible
multiple pus discharging fistulae from the lower mandible
gingival recession at the lower incisor tooth (teeth 31 and 32) region

treatments_received: admitted to Princess Margaret Hospital (ward maintenance fees for 18-20 November 2012)
urgent CT scan and radiographic investigations
conservative treatment of mandibular fractures with antibiotics and soft diet
outpatient follow-up with dental and surgical units
treatments_future: extensive resection of the necrotic bone in the mandible followed by immediate fibular microvascular bone flap reconstruction of the mandible
10 post-surgical sessions of hyperbaric oxygen treatment
dental implant supported over-denture (implant rehabilitation) and possible removal of maxillary long-span bridge for assessment

losses.description: Pain and discomfort for a few months after the assault; temporary injuries (mandibular fractures, facial tenderness, left elbow abrasion) causing months of pain and discomfort
visible depressed scar with loss of subcutaneous tissue at the midline of lower lip/chin (related to prior tongue carcinoma surgery)

losses.category: Loss of ability to enjoy food and drink
losses.description: inability to chew solid food and restriction to soft/liquid diet
